title: Building Trades: Data-Center Counties vs. Others
units: Electrical, plumbing and HVAC contractors; percent change, 2021–22 to 2025–26
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages; Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers; author's calculations.
note: Building-equipment contractors (NAICS 2382), private sector, four-quarter averages, 2021Q2–2022Q1 to 2025Q2–2026Q1. Major data-center counties have $1 billion or more of construction at frontier AI data centers coming online from mid-2022 through 2026. Counties with at least 250 such jobs at the start.
